headline: EPS surges sequentially and rises year-over-year
summary_short: Boozt reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of SEK 1.63, up 858.8% q/q from SEK 0.17 and up 35.8% y/y from SEK 1.20.
summary_long: EPS of SEK 1.63 rose sharply, up 858.8% sequentially from SEK 0.17 and 35.8% year-over-year from SEK 1.20. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
